reviewContext.userProblem: The user wants Rust ports of the permissively licensed DSP components bundled in the Behringer KICK (0700-AAM) and IGNITE (0716-AAF) open firmware (Airwindows, TinySoundFont tsf.h/tml.h, smbPitchShift, stftPitchShift, dywapitchtrack) in the host-agnostic music-things workspace. The ports must come from the original upstream sources, never from Music Tribe AGPL code, and must have automated parity evidence against the upstream C/C++. This run is batch 1 of 3.
requiredOutcomes: crates/airwindows (music-things-airwindows) implements the frozen framework (AirwindowsEffect trait, ParamInfo/PluginInfo, seeded fpd dither, AwRand, display helpers, create/create_with_seed/catalog) and all 110 batch-1 plugins (kick-airwindows-set.txt lines 1-110, Acceleration..DitherMeDiskers). Each plugin has metadata, factory registration and a parity test against committed harness fixtures.

crates/soundfont (music-things-soundfont) ports tsf.h (font load, synth runtime, every public tsf_channel_* function) and tml.h (midi::parse, info, tempo_value), with parity on synthetic SF2/MIDI files built in test code.

crates/pitch (music-things-pitch) ports smbPitchShift (SmbPitchShifter), stftPitchShift (StftPitchShift, StftPitchShiftStream, RFFT port) and dywapitchtrack (PitchTracker), with realtime-safe APIs and parity tests.
The facade crates/music-things gains the optional features airwindows, soundfont and pitch (re-exports only; no default features).

MIT reference harnesses live under tools/ (written from scratch, including the VST shim) and compile the upstream code in place from $MUSIC_THINGS_REFS. Committed fixtures stay within budget: airwindows <= 1600000 bytes, soundfont <= 400000, pitch <= 600000, total <= 3000000.
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and README.md list every component with upstream URL, pinned revision and license text. AGENTS.md Project Structure lists the new crates and tools/.

Workspace gates pass: cargo nextest run --workspace; cargo build --workspace --target wasm32-unknown-unknown; cargo build -p music-things --all-features --target wasm32-unknown-unknown; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo clippy -p music-things --all-features -- -D warnings; cargo fmt --check.
nonGoals: No Airwindows plugins beyond the 110 batch-1 plugins, and no stubs for the other 219 (batches 2 and 3 are later runs).

No processDoubleReplacing, chunks or programs for Airwindows; no tsf_render_short and no file/stream loaders for tsf/tml; no i16 public API for smb; no other FFT than the RFFT.h port; no streaming MIDI parser.
No edits to the root Cargo.toml, mise.toml, or crates other than crates/airwindows, crates/soundfont, crates/pitch and the facade features in crates/music-things.
No copying of upstream C/C++ into the repository, and never reading Music Tribe AGPL sources (KICK/IGNITE AudIO, Kick, Source).
No CI or mise task for fixture regeneration (non-blocking pending default in design-docs/user-qa/pending-behringer-oss-ports-batch1.md).
constraints: Port only from the pinned upstream refs under $MUSIC_THINGS_REFS=/Users/taco/gits/tacogips/music-things-refs (airwindows @ b110fac3991fff7c4655cc2d25d6a3e221f9799c, TinySoundFont @ 853a0a171759f1ddba0de1442133a75912bbeffa, stftPitchShift @ 70c96db087458f8631edbc1bb4068d42ea5b52cc, dywapitchtrack 0.1.0.1, smbPitchShift 1.2). Keep upstream copyright and license headers in ported files.
New crates have no dependencies and no dev-dependencies, are host-agnostic, use an f32 audio API with an explicit sample rate, and build for wasm32-unknown-unknown.
Allocation happens only in constructors and loaders. process, render, note_on, channel/controller calls and push never allocate; a counting-global-allocator test per component enforces this.
Every Rust file stays under 1000 lines.
Each plan edits only its writePaths and formats only owned files with rustfmt --edition 2021. Workspace-wide cargo fmt --check runs only as a gate in bop-18.
No git checkout, stash or reset, or any other tree-rewriting git operation; sibling plans share the working directory.

Each plan's evidence goes under tmp/behringer-oss-ports/<planId>/ (intent.md, pre-hashes.txt, post-hashes.txt, logs/). Verification records use {command, exitStatus: 0, testsRun, testsPassed, failureCount: 0, outcome: "passed", log, notes}. Negative-control runs go in mutationEvidence.
Harness compile flags: -O1 -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math -fno-builtin. The airwindows harness asserts long double == double.
Cargo env: CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true NEXTEST_STATUS_LEVEL=fail NEXTEST_FAILURE_OUTPUT=immediate-final NEXTEST_HIDE_PROGRESS_BAR=1.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Additive Airwindows registration (plugins/mod.rs -> batchN/mod.rs -> batchN/gNN/mod.rs -> one file per plugin), so batches 2 and 3 never edit framework files, and group plans own disjoint directories.

bop-01 freezes the framework and generates all 220 batch-1 fixture files before any group plan starts, so group plans never edit tools/. Harness defects escalate to bop-01, and the affected plugin is marked BLOCKED.
Deterministic seeding (D5): fpd_from_seed(seed, lane) with lowbias32, plus the AwRand stream replacing libc rand(). The harness seeds the same stream and overrides fpd after construction.

Parity classes for Airwindows: Exact (bit-identical), Libm (max-abs <= 1e-6), and Custom(x) only with a written reason. Other tolerances: tml exact; font load ints exact and floats relative 1e-6; tsf render max-abs <= 1e-5; smb <= 3 LSB in the int16 domain; stft offline <= 1e-5 and stream vs offline <= 1e-6; dywa relative 1e-9 with identical pitch/no-pitch decisions.

A shared deterministic stimulus (C in tools/common/stimulus.h, Rust twins in tests/common/) uses basic IEEE ops only, and its FNV-1a-64 checksum is asserted in every parity test to catch generator drift.
SoundFont is split into midi/, font/ and synth/ modules owned by bop-16a, bop-16b and bop-16c. The internal Region, Preset and Envelope structs mirror tsf field for field as the 16b->16c contract.

Plan DAG has 4 waves: W1 bop-00; W2 bop-01, bop-16a, bop-16b, bop-17a, bop-17b, bop-17c; W3 bop-02..bop-15 and bop-16c; W4 bop-18. Cargo.lock is written only by bop-00 and bop-18. Files that change owner across waves (airwindows gNN/mod.rs and fixtures/batch1/gNN) are ordered by dependencies.
Fixture budgets are measured in apparent bytes (the sum of file lengths, matching the fixture_budget tests), not du block counts.
intentionalTradeoffs: D1: display strings follow a clean-room float2string/dB2string/int2string spec shared by the MIT shim and Rust. Character-exact Steinberg SDK formatting is not claimed.
D2: StftPitchShiftStream has no upstream counterpart and is verified only against the ported offline path.
D3: dywapitchtrack takes an explicit sample rate and is identical to upstream at 44100 Hz.
D4: tsf channels are capped at 16 with preallocated storage (lazy activation below the cap mirrors tsf), and the voice pool is fixed at construction.
D6: no processDoubleReplacing, chunks or programs; reset() is added.
D7: smbPitchShift uses f32 I/O and omits both int16 conversions. Parity is proven through the int16 bridge.
D8: constructors return ConfigError for configurations where upstream has undefined behavior (smb frame/osamp, stft hopsize 0, dywa window/hop).
Tolerances are measured only on aarch64-apple-darwin, and a bound is widened only by a documented design update.
supportedEdgeCases: Airwindows: an unknown plugin name gives None; lookup by upstream_name works (Console8BusOut -> Console8BussOut); set_param clamps to [0,1] and ignores NaN and out-of-range indices; process handles the min of the four slice lengths; reset re-renders bit-identically; plugins without fpdL/fpdR are detected at compile time in the harness.

SoundFont: truncated SF2 and MIDI inputs return Err; a sample rate of 0 becomes 44100 as upstream; voice exhaustion under max_voices; channel index >= 16 is a no-op that returns the failure value; lazy channel activation, inactive-channel getter fallbacks, unguarded note_off/note_off_all/sounds_off_all voice scans, and reset deactivation; mixing vs overwrite render.

Pitch: invalid smb frame size/osamp, stft framesize 1 or not a power of two, analysis < synthesis, hopsize 0, empty or too many factors, dywa non-power-of-two window or hop 0 (and hop > window, a D3 streaming-API check noted in residual finding S5-L1); smb chunk-size invariance; stft asymmetric frames (C3) and a non-divisor hop accepted when upstream accepts it; dywa push sequence equals compute sequence.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Cross-host libm calibration (glibc, wasm libm) beyond the stated bounds; only aarch64-apple-darwin is the acceptance host.
Copyrighted SoundFonts and real-world MIDI files; tests use synthetic inputs only.
Batch-2 and batch-3 Airwindows plugins (kick list line 111 onward, starting with DitherMeTimbers).
residualFindings: S5-L1 (low, bop-17c): PitchTracker::new returns InvalidValue when hop > window, which D8 does not list. It applies only to the D3 streaming API; the implementer notes it in the module's D3/D8 docs.
S5-L2 (low, bop-01): the airwindows byte budget is tight (the .f32 files alone are 1,330,560 of 1,600,000 bytes). An overrun is escalated, not solved by raising the threshold.
S5-L3 (low, bop-16c): stale risk text only; design lines 252-255 and bop-16c agree that note-off scans are unguarded. No action needed.
